about: Massachusetts state grant calls entered by hand from each program's own page: Massachusetts has no state catalog here (docs/state-coverage.md), so this is not a statewide list. Calls posted on mass.gov are entered on permission: verbal, by phone to Ren, 2026-11-27, not yet in writing. It covers mass.gov only. The two Massachusetts Technology Collaborative (MassTech) calls are from masstech.org, as before. grantmatch/local.py checks this file and turns each entry into a Massachusetts program record; the weekly page watcher rereads every page. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date.

programs.title: Pathmaker Training Provider grants (advanced manufacturing, AI, defense and robotics)
programs.objectives: Direct funding to build and expand training programs that prepare students for careers in advanced manufacturing, AI, defense and robotics. Applicants need at least one industry partner with a direct hiring need.
programs.who: Community-based organizations (including those relying on a fiscal agent), nonprofit entities, workforce development organizations, MassHire boards and career centers, municipalities, community colleges, colleges and universities, comprehensive and vocational high schools, and for-profit companies whose training is open to the public.
programs.application: Read the full requirements and apply from the MassTech page. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
programs.award: The amount isn't stated on the page.
programs.deadlines: Rolling. The page gives an initial deadline of Friday, January 8 and a final FY27 deadline of Friday, April 16; MassTech's list of grant opportunities dates it April 16, 2027.
programs.source_note: The scoring criteria mention matching funds, but the page doesn't say whether a match is required. The full requirements weren't opened.
programs.subjects: Workforce development; Job training; Manufacturing; Artificial intelligence; Robotics; Education

programs.title: Cyber Resilient Massachusetts Grant Program
programs.objectives: Grants toward cybersecurity monitoring and response services (managed detection and response and related services) from CyberTrust Massachusetts.
programs.who: Municipalities, small businesses and nonprofits in Massachusetts. Nonprofits in sectors such as health care and digital health, AI, climate technology, manufacturing and entrepreneur support are given priority.
programs.application: First get a scope of work from CyberTrust Massachusetts, then include it in the application to MassTech.
programs.award: Up to one third of the cost of the CyberTrust Massachusetts services, plus an onboarding fee if there is one, for up to three years. Nonprofits are paid by reimbursement.
programs.match: At least two thirds of the service cost
programs.deadlines: Applications are due on a rolling basis.

programs.title: Social Enterprise Operating Grant, FY2027
programs.objectives: Grants to nonprofits that run social enterprise businesses employing, training and supporting people with significant barriers to employment. Money may go to marketing and customer acquisition, materials and supplies, and staff training.
programs.who: Nonprofit organizations that operate social enterprise businesses.
programs.application: Read the request for proposals and apply from the mass.gov page.
programs.deadlines: Applications are due December 7, 2026 at 11:59 p.m.
programs.source_note: The request for proposals and the questions and answers (PDF files) weren't opened: check them for who may apply and any match.
programs.subjects: Workforce development; Social enterprise; Employment; Job training

programs.title: Wastewater Energy Recovery Pilot Grant, 2026 to 2028
programs.objectives: Pilot grants for recovering heat energy from wastewater. Phase I assessment and Phase II design applications are being accepted.
programs.who: Publicly and privately owned wastewater facilities, municipal and state buildings, public and private colleges and universities, and nonprofit and privately owned organizations.
programs.application: Pre-register in the Executive Office of Energy and Environmental Affairs' Grant Management System and apply there. The request for responses is linked from the page.
programs.award: The page gives $5 million for the pilot and no amount for one grant.
programs.deadlines: Rolling, first come, first served, until funds run out. The page's procurement calendar says through May 31, 2028; an April 2026 update on the same page says May 26, 2028.
programs.source_note: The notice and request for responses (PDF files) weren't opened.

programs.title: MassTrails Grants, 2027 round
programs.agency: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
programs.objectives: Trail planning, design and permitting, building and maintaining trails, trailhead amenities, trail equipment and, in limited cases, buying easements or land for trails.
programs.who: Municipalities, nonprofit organizations, federally or state-recognized tribal governments, Massachusetts departments and federal agencies.
programs.application: Apply online through the MassTrails application portal linked from the mass.gov page.
programs.award: Up to $500,000 for shared-use paths (one year); up to $100,000 for other trails (two years).
programs.deadlines: Applications must be received by 11:59 p.m. on February 2, 2027. For projects on DCR land, a signed DCR trail proposal form is due to DCR by December 1 before that.
programs.subjects: Trails; Recreation; Parks; Conservation; Outdoor access

programs.title: Land Acquisition for Forest Reserves Grant, FY27 round
programs.objectives: Money to permanently conserve forest land, to be passively managed so older forest can mature, by buying the land or a conservation restriction.
programs.who: Qualified 501(c)(3) organizations formed for land conservation, municipalities, and other conservation organizations such as land banks.
programs.application: Apply through the Energy and Environmental Affairs Grant Management System, with appraisal reports, a project description, maps and a budget.
programs.award: Up to $425,000. Reimburses 50% of eligible project costs.
programs.deadlines: Applications must be submitted by Thursday, February 18, 2027 at 11:59 p.m.

programs.title: Landscape Partnership Grant, FY27 round
programs.objectives: Money to protect large blocks of conservation land by buying land or a conservation, agricultural preservation or watershed preservation restriction. The minimum acreage depends on the county.
programs.who: Two or more partners applying jointly, from: municipalities, nonprofit 501(c)(3) organizations, nonprofit non-municipal public water suppliers, government agencies and tribal governments.
programs.application: Apply with a partner through the Energy and Environmental Affairs Grant Management System.
programs.deadlines: Applications must be submitted by March 11, 2027 at 11:59 p.m.
programs.source_note: An application must come from two or more partners together. The bid document wasn't opened.
